name: roadmap_conntrack
heading: Task board
passage: 12 consecutive failed conntrack -D attempts or a missing binary fail isolation closed
erratum: - `docs/ROADMAP.md`, [“Task board”](../ROADMAP.md#task-board), the done row `w2-agent-core follow-up 15`: the row still says twelve consecutive failed `conntrack -D` attempts, or a missing binary, fail isolation closed, and that the count persists across restarts. The current bound is twelve durably reserved serving-Apply delete batches (`maxConntrackDeleteAttempts`). The reservation is stored before Apply. A crash or an earlier failure consumes a reservation. A missing `conntrack` binary does not use this count; `LookPath` fails closed at once. See [desired state and leases](../node/README.md#desired-state-and-leases-147-163).

name: roadmap_capture
heading: Task board
passage: revoke completion fence matches only peers that share an exit group with the member plan
erratum: - `docs/ROADMAP.md`, [“Task board”](../ROADMAP.md#task-board), the done row `w3-wire-nodes follow-up 22`: the row still says revoke completion matches only peers that share an exit group with the member plan and were observed inside 90 seconds, and that an ungrouped exit never holds a revoke. A member or device `nodes` step succeeds after its capture is finished and no captured target remains `pending`. One reporting node's clean observation does not settle another node's pending target. An `unconfirmed` target does not block success. See [publishing exits](operator-guide.md#33-publishing-disabling-and-unpublishing-exits-put-apiv1adminnodesnode_idpublication).

name: followup52_capture
heading: Guide revisions at this cut
erratum: - `docs/handover/follow-up-52.md`, [“Guide revisions at this cut”](follow-up-52.md#guide-revisions-at-this-cut): the operator-guide row says revoke-step completion follows `advanceNodeOperationsOnObservation`, and that one clean counting observation can complete the step while another fresh exit has not applied its generation. `advanceNodeOperationsOnObservation` selects operations whose `resource_type` is `node`. Member and device targets are updated by `observeOperationTargets`, which selects only the reporting node's rows. Success requires a finished capture and no remaining `pending` target. See [publishing exits](operator-guide.md#33-publishing-disabling-and-unpublishing-exits-put-apiv1adminnodesnode_idpublication).

name: followup54_pool
heading: Merged deliveries
passage: pool connections scan timestamps in UTC
erratum: - `docs/handover/follow-up-54.md`, [“Merged deliveries”](follow-up-54.md#merged-deliveries), the #533 effect: the sentence says pool connections scan timestamps in UTC. Pool connections scan scalar `timestamptz` values, and ranges and multiranges of it, in UTC; arrays of `timestamptz` keep pgx's default element codec, so elements scanned into `pgtype.Timestamptz` can carry the host's zone, while elements scanned into `time.Time` are UTC; no product query scans such an array (`internal/db/db.go` `ConfigureUTC`, lines 76–85 and 94–98). See [`ConfigureUTC`](../../internal/db/db.go).

name: node_deadline
heading: Follow-up 23 timing evidence (2026-10-31)
erratum: - `docs/node/README.md`, [“Follow-up 23 timing evidence (2026-10-31)”](../node/README.md#follow-up-23-timing-evidence-2026-10-31), under [“待實測”](../node/README.md#待實測): the note says `decide.go` and `deadline.go` floor remaining member allowances to whole seconds, and it names `TestISOF603_WholeSecondRendererLimit`. Member allowances truncate to `DeadlineGranularity` (1 millisecond) after the install reserve. `probeTimeout` still uses whole seconds, and only for synthetic probes. nft 1.0.9 JSON read-back remains whole seconds. `TestISOF603_WholeSecondRendererLimit` is not in the tree. `TestISOF603_RenewalFailureAndDeadline` is the expiry test, and `TestD104_SubsecondDeadline` covers a sub-second render (`node/agent/followup23_expiry_test.go`). See [what the agent sends and installs](../node/2026-10-31-d104-d106-agent.md#what-the-agent-sends-and-installs) and [the deadline contract interface](../poc/G2-deadline-contract-2026-10-31.md#interface-for-agent-core-follow-up-24).
